resources.title: Quick start
resources.note: Shortest path to a first call: get a key, send one state with typed questions, read the answers

resources.title: API reference
resources.note: HTTP reference for POST /v1/systemone: request body (state, model, questions), answer shapes per question type, rate-limit handling

resources.title: Primitives (Questions)
resources.note: Overview of the three question types (Choice, Score, Noul), what each returns, how to pick one, and how to ask several in one call

resources.title: Choice
resources.note: Choice picks one option from a declared set and returns the selected option, a probability per option, and a confidence value

resources.title: Score
resources.note: Score rates the state against ordered descriptive levels and returns a score, a probability per level, and a confidence value

resources.title: Noul
resources.note: Noul asks a yes/no question and returns the probability that the answer is yes

resources.title: State
resources.note: What state is, how to structure it (string, JSON object or array), and how to give the model the context a question needs

resources.title: Confidence
resources.note: How TypeSafe reports certainty, how confidence differs from probability, and how to use it to decide whether code should act

resources.title: Models
resources.note: Model card for jev-1.13.0: $0.042 per million input tokens, free output, rate limits, 64k context (32k for state), text-only input

resources.title: Jev 1.13 jaggedness
resources.note: TypeSafe's own list of known weak spots in jev-1.13, which it says will be fixed in later versions; read before designing questions

resources.title: How to build with TypeSafe
resources.note: Design guidance: keep code in control of flow and side effects, and hand the model only narrow, structured decisions

resources.title: Patterns
resources.note: Index of four architecture patterns: speculative fan-out, confidence-gated routing, composite scoring, and intent routing

resources.title: Agent skill
resources.note: Install commands for a skill that gives Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents the question types, patterns and API usage

resources.title: Parallel questions
resources.note: Cookbook: 13 questions over the GDPR Wikipedia article; TypeSafe reports one batched call is 12.2x cheaper and 10.0x faster than 13 single calls

resources.title: Re-ranking
resources.note: Cookbook: re-ranks 30-passage BM25 shortlists for 40 CLERC legal queries; TypeSafe reports top-1 going from 5% to 18% and top-10 from 38% to 62%

resources.title: Guardrails for LLMs
resources.note: Cookbook: screen messages into and out of an LLM app with hazard questions and a severity score, then threshold to pass, review or block

resources.title: Classifying RAG passages
resources.note: Cookbook: score each retrieved passage in one request, then decide in code which reach the answering model; drops prompt-injection passages

resources.title: Function calling
resources.note: Cookbook: maps natural-language trading requests to typed function calls by turning function names and closed-set arguments into questions

resources.title: Jev (typesafe)
resources.note: Cloudflare AI model page for typesafe/jev: 32,000-token context, env.AI.run and curl examples with Noul, Choice and Score, plus sample responses

resources.title: TypeSafe Jev now available in AI Gateway
resources.note: Netlify changelog: call Jev from Netlify Functions via @typesafe-ai/sdk with no API key setup, billed to Netlify credits; includes a contact-form routing example

resources.title: AI SDK Providers: TypeSafe
resources.note: Docs for @ai-sdk/typesafe-ai: experimental_evaluate with choice, score and boolean (Noul) questions, limits per type, rounding, confidence metadata, retries

resources.title: Testing TypeSafe Jev, Mistral and Gemini for local event validation
resources.note: Near Here reports Jev matched 48/50 event-listing decisions vs 43 for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and 42 for Mistral Small 4, at 0.59s and $0.043 per 1,000 decisions

resources.title: Mini-Vibe Check: TypeSafe's Jev Judged Everything I've Written in 0.7 Seconds
resources.note: Every's head of evals ran Jev over his own writing; the free preview explains the yes/no-probability idea and says accuracy is still open. Rest needs an account

resources.title: jev 同士に五目並べで対戦させた
resources.note: mizchi had Jev play gomoku against itself via one Choice over legal moves; a 25-move game took 13.9s, about 500ms per move, with confidence logged per move. Repo linked

resources.title: TypeSafeのJevを正しく驚く、それってLLMでできませんか？
resources.note: Author rebuilt the parallel-answer trick with Gemma3 270M first-token logits and reports 77x over JSON output; in a Mario harness Jev still beat the older LLMs tried

resources.title: Jev means structured output is interesting again
resources.note: Skeptical read: argues prefilling a normal LLM and sampling one constrained token gets most of the speed (he reports 2-3x on Qwen2.5-1.5B) and doubts a technical moat

resources.title: Typed Decisions, Not Chat
resources.note: Briefing that sets each launch claim against TypeSafe's own footnotes: eval labels come from two LLMs, the 0% hallucination figure is not empirical, no paper or weights

resources.title: Jev: The Language Model That Won't Talk
resources.note: Analysis from secondary sources: Jev 67.8% vs GPT Sol 74.1% on TypeSafe's evals, RLCD unpublished, and calibrated answers need not compose into a calibrated workflow

resources.title: He Says He Co-Invented ChatGPT. His New AI, Jev, Won't Write a Word
resources.note: TypeScript ticket-triage walkthrough with the AI SDK provider plus a threshold routing function; no live run (author had no key), numbers are vendor-reported

resources.title: AI That Doesn't Talk: A Plain-English Guide to TypeSafe's Jev
resources.note: Long beginner guide with Python SDK snippets, use cases by industry, a list of reasons to stay skeptical, and a shadow-run rollout plan. No testing of its own

resources.title: What Is Jev? How to Implement Typesafe AI’s Decision Model (Practical Guide)
resources.note: Python SDK intro plus a proposed (not built) use in the author's chargeback tool; test results quoted are Every's, not his own

resources.title: TypeSafe JEV Explained: AI Decisions Without a Chatbot
resources.note: Short non-technical explainer of the launch post and RLCD; all figures are company-reported and the only counterpoint is that general LLMs keep getting cheaper

resources.title: TypeSafe Jev: the First Decision-Only Model Class, Benchmarked and Priced
resources.note: Rewrite of the launch post and evals site: per-model accuracy/cost/latency table, pricing, curl example. No testing of its own; repeats TypeSafe's caveats

resources.title: TypeSafe AI debuts model for machines that plays Doom
resources.note: Launch coverage: $40M funding, typed probabilistic output, the Doom demo, pricing, and why "hallucination-free" is not a fair comparison since answers can still be wrong

resources.title: LLMの193倍速い“判断だけのAI”「Jev」、ChatGPTの共著研究者が開発
resources.note: Japanese launch report; notes Almeida is one of about 20 InstructGPT co-authors, not ChatGPT's inventor, and that 193.6x/444.6x come from TypeSafe's own evals

resources.title: [AINews] Jev: a “System One Model” that only decides/classifies/routes/scores — >100x faster, >200x cheaper than small frontier LLMs
resources.note: Daily roundup leading with the launch; the Jev part is a short digest of X reactions (classifier/judge/router use, "not a GPT replacement", DSPy parallels)

resources.title: Browser Use's Jev Ultrafast Cuts Browser Agent Costs 90% With Indexed DOM Actions
resources.note: Reports Browser Use's MIT-licensed agent where Jev picks an action and element index per step; Google Flights demo in about 7s at a reported $0.0039. Paywalled midway

resources.title: Livestream Coding with the new TypeSafe AI JEV Model | Parallel Constrained Decoding
resources.note: Livestream (about 2h19m) breaking down Jev and sketching network architectures for JSON-predictor models; per the description the content starts near 6:57

resources.title: 100x Faster? He Co-Created ChatGPT. Now He Built the Opposite: Meet Jev.
resources.note: Launch walkthrough with sources on screen: blog caveats, Doom and Wikiracing demos, the two outside tests, 'can't hallucinate' read closely, X thread questions

resources.title: Jev by TypeSafe AI: Jev vs LLMs - Parallel Sampling, Lower Latency, and Typed Outputs
resources.note: Nine-minute explainer: parallel sampling vs autoregression, RLCD, the primitives, an expense-claim example, and limits around semantic errors and auditability

resources.title: Introducing System One Models and Jev
resources.note: Main launch thread (1,871 points, about 490 comments): whether the speed comparison is apples-to-oranges, classifier/encoder parallels, and requests for demo code

resources.title: Reverse-engineered Jev-like model
resources.note: Thread on the jevlike repo (160 points): replication attempts, a commenter reporting a DiffusionGemma "Jev mode" at about 0.2s per decision, and a Qwen-2.5-1B clone

resources.title: OpenJev
resources.note: Thread on openjev.com (108 points, 53 comments): commenters note it is unaffiliated, emulates Jev with Qwen3 0.6B, takes 0.5-2s on an M2 Max, and question the name

resources.title: Open-sourced jev architecture last year with model,paper and dataset
resources.note: Author claims a March 2025 arXiv paper (2503.23303) with open model and dataset used a similar non-autoregressive probability design; replies debate credit

resources.title: pngwn/open-jev
resources.note: Gradio demo of the pngwn Qwen3.5-4B scorer: prefill state once, score all question/option branches in parallel; card reports 0.740 accuracy, ECE 0.047 on 500 Gradio PRs

resources.title: monotykamary/LFM2.5-2.6B-RLCD
resources.note: Inference-only parallel constrained decoding on unchanged LFM2.5-2.6B; card reports ~9.9x speedup on L40S but 72.2% field accuracy on fresh cases vs 94.4% for AR JSON

resources.title: com-kotobalabs/open-jev-deberta-v3-large
resources.note: DeBERTa-v3-large with a span head for choice/score/noul, trained on banking77, SST-5 and BoolQ gold labels; card reports 0.854 in-domain and 0.690 OOD accuracy

resources.title: mobarmg/jev-schema-scorer-deberta-v3-large
resources.note: DeBERTa-v3-large scalar scorer over (state, question+candidate) pairs, trained on 7,650 synthetic questions in 30 domains; card reports 0.889 choice acc, 0.940 noul acc

resources.title: pngwn/system-one-qwen3.5-4b-scorer
resources.note: Qwen3.5-4B-Base with LoRA r=16 and a scalar option-scoring head, 12,913 questions, 9 task families; card reports 0.707 test accuracy, ECE 0.044 after temperature scaling

resources.title: reachjalil/jevlogs-log-triage-benchmark
resources.note: 5,000 sanitized Loghub HDFS/BGL log lines with live Jev routing decisions and token counts; card reports 0.993 HDFS recall but only 0.84% of lines filtered out

resources.title: Mikhail/mini-jev-runs
resources.note: 27,900 decision records with fp32 option-letter logits from frozen Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on CLINC150; card reports 0.848 accuracy and scores that are not calibrated

resources.title: harshatheg/Qwen-2.5-1B-RLCD
resources.note: MLX inference code, no new weights: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit scores enum/boolean JSON fields in parallel; card reports 5.6x-7.0x speedup vs autoregressive (M4 Max)

resources.title: multimodalart/jev-reproductions-tracker
resources.note: Static Space listing open Jev reproduction attempts in one grid (decoding tricks, diffusion, trained scorers, prior art, explainers), sorted by an engagement score

resources.title: shreyansh26/Qwen-2.5-1B-RLCD
resources.note: PyTorch server code, no fine-tuned weights: batched and FlexAttention tree scoring of enum/boolean fields on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct; card gives no benchmark numbers

resources.title: notnotsamuel/LFM2.5-350M-RLCD
resources.note: Inference-only constrained field scoring on unchanged LFM2.5-350M; card reports 8.46x (M2 Max) to 62.91x (L40S) speedup on 28 booleans at 60.7-64.3% field accuracy

resources.title: pngwn/system-one-qwen3.5-4b-scorer-v2b
resources.note: v2 retrain of the pngwn Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA scorer on 45,932 questions for 2 epochs; card reports 0.803 val accuracy and ECE 0.022 (val split only, n=5,087)

resources.title: heman10x/rlcd-modernbert-151m
resources.note: 151M GLiClass ModernBERT-base classifier with CE+Brier loss, temperature scaling, an abstain slot; card reports 95.0% top-1 and 3.35% ECE on 1,000 Banking77-based cases

resources.title: aahf/JevBenchmark
resources.note: Static article comparing Jev, GPT-5.6 Sol and XGBoost on four synthetic ad outcomes; card reports similar quality at ~64x lower estimated API cost and 5.4x lower latency

resources.title: SargeDev/jev-distill-corpus
resources.note: 148,160 query-passage rows with 0-7 graded relevance from a typed-judgment (Choice) API and a 32B teacher; card reports 91.0% binary agreement, Pearson r=0.897

resources.title: epsilon3/Qwen-2.5-1B-RLCD-Fast
resources.note: Tree-attention variant of harshatheg's inference code on unchanged Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct; card reports up to 2.37x faster field decode and 98% less extra memory on M4 Pro

resources.title: Foodoo1/Qwen3-14B-RLCD-Decision-LoRA
resources.note: QLoRA on Qwen3-14B with loss on the single decision token, 4,152 synthetic fraud-triage cases; card reports 98.8% vs 85.2% base on 200 held-out synthetic cases, 4 fields

resources.title: DavidHatley/system-one-mini
resources.note: 69.3M DistilBERT with five fixed classification heads over synthetic software-diagnosis summaries; card says not a Jev reproduction, reports 86.25% final-set accuracy

resources.title: reachjalil/jevlogs-triage-explorer
resources.note: Gradio explorer for the jevlogs log-triage benchmark; makes no live Jev calls and recomputes routing from saved probabilities on sanitized Loghub HDFS and BGL samples

resources.title: mobarmg/jev-schema-scorer
resources.note: Gradio demo and API for mobarmg/jev-schema-scorer-deberta-v3-large; you write your own choice/noul/score schema and it returns per-question distributions

resources.title: Eloiselatourdepise/qwen-rlcd-demo
resources.note: Static in-browser (WebGPU/WASM) side-by-side demo of harshatheg/Qwen-2.5-1B-RLCD parallel constrained decoding vs autoregressive JSON generation; card gives no numbers

resources.title: pngwn/system-one-demo
resources.note: Gradio demo of the pngwn Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA scorer next to Qwen3.5-4B instruct; card reports 0.705 test accuracy, ECE 0.046 and ~112 ms per query at 16 options or fewer

resources.title: reachjalil/jev-luna-pagerduty-trigger
resources.note: 3,000 synthetic checkout/payments log lines with page/no-page gold labels plus Jev and GPT-5.6 Luna runs; card reports Jev v3 at p>=0.50 with 1.000 recall and precision

resources.title: reachjalil/jev-tree-choice-cap
resources.note: 180 synthetic tickets over a 320-leaf incident taxonomy testing Jev's 255-option Choice cap; card reports authored tree walk 180/180 vs 90/180 when truncating to 255

resources.title: pngwn/system-one-decisions
resources.note: Training set for the pngwn scorer: 12,913/1,452/1,751 rows of state, typed question, options, answer index; card body is the upstream support-ticket dataset text

resources.title: DavidHatley/system-one-mini-data
resources.note: 28,000 deterministic synthetic software-diagnosis summaries with five fixed labels, used to train DavidHatley/system-one-mini; card says not a Jev or RLCD reproduction
